get.description: Liveness: the process answers. No dependencies are touched.
Readiness: database, Redis and object storage all answer.

post.description: Exchange Mini App initData (validated server-side) for an access token.
Sliding session: a valid token buys a fresh one while the app is open.

schema.title: Response List Presets Api V1 Presets Get

get.description: One asset with its derived files (proxy, poster, filmstrip), shots and metadata.
Words with timings, segments, silences and subtitle cues (``transcript/1``).

post.description: Transcribe (again), optionally forcing a language when detection got it wrong.

Run ingestion again (after a media-engine update). Derived files are
rewritten in place; the original is only read.
Open (or resume) a resumable multipart upload for one file.

get.description: Upload state, including the parts storage already holds (for resume).

post.description: Presigned PUT URLs for parts; each signature covers the part's Content-MD5.
Verify every part in storage, assemble the original and queue ingestion.

get.description: Activity log. Default: the latest ``limit`` events, oldest first.
Server-Sent Events: replay after ``Last-Event-ID`` / ``after_id``, then live.

ColorInfo.title: ColorInfo
ColorInfo.description:
Source color detection (spec §11 SOURCE DETECTION). Phase 8 builds the
full transform chain on top of this; ingestion only needs to know enough
to make a viewable proxy and to flag Log/HDR material.

EventEnvelope.title: EventEnvelope
EventEnvelope.description: Wire format of an event, identical for the REST log and the SSE stream.

JobQueue.title: JobQueue
JobQueue.description: Separate queues so heavy work never starves light work (spec §30-31).

storage_reserved_bytes.title: Storage Reserved Bytes
storage_reserved_bytes.description: Declared size of uploads still in progress

Segment.title: Segment
Segment.description: Roughly a sentence (the engine's segmentation, split at long pauses).

SignedUrl.title: SignedUrl
SignedUrl.description: Short-lived presigned GET on the Mini App's own origin.

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: Development phase in which this stage becomes operational

available.title: Available
available.description: False until the stage's phase has been built

SubtitleCue.title: SubtitleCue
SubtitleCue.description:
Preset-neutral subtitle data: ≤ 2 lines. ``word_start``/``word_end``
(exclusive) index ``Transcript.words``, so per-word timing stays available
for animated captions without storing every word twice. The Caption agent
(Phase 7) re-flows and styles these per output format.

TranscriptSummary.title: TranscriptSummary
TranscriptSummary.description:
The state of an asset's transcription; the words themselves come from
``GET /assets/{id}/transcript``.
